subject: CRITICAL: RP8/RP9 have 74.1% answer overlap - Kai can memorize
body: GP test gp-rp8-rp9-answer-overlap-check confirms 74.1% numeric answer overlap between RP8 and RP9. With 74% of answers identical, Kai can memorize answer patterns across exams rather than learning the material. This defeats the purpose of multiple retake versions. Bug B-GP-RP6RP7-COLLISION was filed previously - this test now permanently tracks it. Action needed: GR should diversify RP8 and RP9 answer values while maintaining mathematical correctness. Suggest: recalculate at least 60% of shared answers with different problem parameters. GP will detect if overlap exceeds 40% threshold going forward.
